description:
# Tracxn API Guide

Welcome to the Tracxn API guide. This document walks you through use cases, setup, and best practices for accessing the Tracxn API. It will help you:

- Build and refine queries
    
- Explore structured API responses
    

---

## Production Overview

- All filters and queries in the Production environment are applied on Tracxn’s full dataset
    
- Results are comprehensive and globally scoped
    

---

## Request Body Structure

The request body should include the following four parameters:

- `filter`: Your filter criteria (e.g., Companies, Transactions, etc.)
    
- `sort`: Define how results should be sorted
    
- `from`: Offset for pagination (default: 0)
    
- `size`: Number of entities per response (default and maximum: 20)
    

---

## Generating API Tokens (Playground & Production)

To get started with the APIs, generate your environment-specific API tokens:

- **Step 1: Log in**
    
    Log in to your Tracxn account
    
- **Step 2: Generate Production Token**
    
    Navigate to:
    
    Data Solutions > API & Developer Tools > Production Environment > API Token
    
    Your Production API Token will be available there
    
- Important: Tokens are environment-specific. Do not reuse between Playground and Production
    

---

## Rate Limits

**Playground Environment**

- 100 API calls per hour
    
- 1,000 API calls per day
    

**Key Metrics APIs**

- 10 API calls per hour
    
- 100 API calls per day
    

**Production Environment**

- 100 API calls per second
    
- 1,000 API calls per minute
    
- 10,000 API calls per hour
    
- 100,000 API calls per day
    

Note: Limits may change without prior notice.

If you exceed the limit, you’ll receive HTTP 429 - Too Many Requests.

---

## Response Codes

| Status Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Success – Request completed successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request – Syntax of query is invalid |
| 401 | Authentication Issue – Token missing or invalid |
| 403 | Unauthorized – Token expired or access denied |
| 404 | Not Found – Endpoint does not exist |
| 405 | Method Not Allowed – Use the correct HTTP method (GET or POST) |
| 429 | Rate Limit Exceeded – Slow down requests |
| 500 | Internal Server Error – Try again later |
| 900 | Credit Limit Exceeded – Contact support to renew |

---

## API Update Notice

- We’re phasing out API Version 2.2 as we transition to Version 3.0.
    
- For details and support with migration, reach out to [apidesk@tracxn.com](https://null).

# Key Metrics API - Investors

## Overview

The Key Metrics API enables users to retrieve aggregated data metrics for various data types, such as companies, funding rounds, investors, and acquisitions. The API supports single-level and two-level aggregation with customizable filters.

---

## Request Details

### URL (Production)

[https://platform.tracxn.com/api/3.0/investors/metric](https://platform.tracxn.com/api/3.0/investors/metric)

### Method

POST

### Headers

| Header | Value | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| accessToken | \[Access Token from Tracxn\] | Yes |
| Content-Type | application/json | Yes |

---

## Aggregation Modes

### One-Level Aggregation

Aggregates the metric over the entire filtered dataset.

``` json
{
  "filter": {
    "<filterName>": "<value>"
  },
  "metric": "<metricName>"
}

 ```

**Example:**

``` json
{
  "filter": {
    "investorFeedId": [
      "572cb232e4b0f2e791b91b0a"
    ]
  },
  "metric": "count"
}

 ```

---

### Two-Level Aggregation

Aggregates the metric and groups the result by a specified field.

``` json
{
  "filter": {
    "<filterName>": "<value>"
  },
  "metric": "<metricName>",
  "bucket": [
    {
      "field": "<aggregationKey>"
    }
  ]
}

 ```

**Example:**

``` json
{
  "filter": {
    "investorFeedId": [
      "572cb232e4b0f2e791b91b0a"
    ]
  },
  "metric": "count",
  "bucket": [
    {
      "field": "investorCountry"
    }
  ]
}

 ```

> **Note:** Only top 20 groups are returned for two-level aggregation. 
  

---

## Metric Name \[Investors\]

| Metric Name | Description | Example Use Case |
| --- | --- | --- |
| count | Total count of entities matching given filters | Get the number of investors |

---

## Allowed Filters and Aggregation Keys for \[Investors\]

### Sector Filters

| Filter | Sample | Aggregation Allowed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `practiceAreaId` | `practiceAreaId`: `["5409cf05e4b0831de3527d64"]` | No |
| `feedId` | `feedId`: `["538ca013e4b01fd726a7b617"]` | No |
| `businessModelHierarchy` | `businessModelHierarchy`: `["5b8e5eae4f0ca1fbcd668f14"]` | No |

### Location Filters

| Filter | Sample | Aggregation Allowed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| country | \["United States", "Israel"\] | No |
| countryAndCountryGroupId | \["58075391e4b00a7b5be3ad99"\] | No |
| continent | \["Asia", "Europe"\] | No |
| continentAndContinentGroupId | \["5cb5bff887870743a49871c1"\] | No |
| city | \["San Francisco", "Boston"\] | No |
| cityId | \["63984bcd3f5d0e242497b55a"\] | No |

### Funding Round Filters

| Filter | Sample | Aggregation Allowed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| transactionFundingRoundCategory | \["Series B", "Series C"\] | No |
| transactionFundingRoundDate | {"min":"01/01/2016", "max":"30/06/2016"} | No |

### Investor Filters

| Filter | Sample | Aggregation Allowed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| investorFeedId | \["572cb232e4b0f2e791b91b0a"\] | Yes |
| investorCountry | \["India"\] | Yes |
| investorCountryAndCountryGroupId | \["cDV7UsUlqFRLlwo1Jbzpwiv8lvqgVUWz4AJdMXJv14o"\] | Yes |
| investorContinent | \["Europe", "Asia"\] | Yes |
| investorContinentAndContinentGroupId | \["gwa3sXOBKAH7ULh7p-IUsREMjhpCh2-NTAqg5OUsozA"\] | Yes |
| investorCity | \["Mumbai"\] | Yes |
| investorCityAndCityGroupId | \["7y5XeWz9TTJnpHUSTrT4I9A0KWcYjTJ6t-KKoWCQ150"\] | Yes |

---

## Sample Request and Response

### One-Level Aggregation

**Sample Request for** **`count`** **with One-Level Aggregation:**

``` json
{
  "filter": {
    "investorCountry": [
      "India"
    ]
  },
  "metric": "count"
}

 ```

**Sample Response:**

``` json
{
  "result": 69643
}

 ```

---

### Two-Level Aggregation

**Sample Request for** **`count`** **with Two-Level Aggregation (by** **`investorFeedId`****):**

``` json
{
  "filter": {
    "investorFeedId": [
      "572cb232e4b0f2e791b91b0a"
    ],
    "investorCountry": [
      "India"
    ]
  },
  "metric": "count",
  "bucket": [
    {
      "field": "investorFeedId"
    }
  ]
}

 ```

**Sample Response:**

``` json
{
  "result": [
    {
      "term": "572cb232e4b0f2e791b91b0a",
      "value": 1408
    }
  ]
}

 ```

---

## Notes

1. All filters apply using **AND** logic
    
2. Two-level aggregation returns **top 20 categories only**
    
3. Ensure a valid `accessToken` is passed in request header
    
4. Metric names are **case-sensitive**

# Time-Series API - Equity (Balance Sheet)

---

The Equity Time-Series API allows you to query the Balance Sheet Equity database and apply multiple filters and sorts.

---

## Request Details

### URL (Production)

[https://platform.tracxn.com/api/3.0/timeseries/balancesheetequity](https://platform.tracxn.com/api/3.0/timeseries/balancesheetequity)

### Method

POST

### Headers

| Header | Value | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| accessToken | \[Access Token from Tracxn\] | Yes |
| Content-Type | application/json | Yes |

---

## Body (Payload)

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `filter` | Criteria to filter equity time-series data |
| `sort` | Criteria to sort the equity time-series data |
| `from` | Pagination offset (default = 0) |
| `size` | Max 100, optional (default = 20) |

---

## Sample Filter

``` json
{
  "from": 0,
  "filter": {
    "companyId": [
      "67a5d7bf767e0424f0c445e0"
    ]
  }
}

 ```

---

## Sample cURL Request

``` bash
curl -X POST \
https://platform.tracxn.com/api/3.0/timeseries/balancesheetequity \
-H 'accesstoken: [access-token-given-by-tracxn]' \
-H 'cache-control: no-cache' \
-H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
-d '{
  "from": 0,
  "filter": {
    "companyId": ["67a5d7bf767e0424f0c445e0"]
  }
}'

 ```

---

## Filters Applicable

### Time-Series Filters

| Filter | Sample | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `companyId` | `["55c88d93e4b07de515b7dfb0"]` | Returns all equity data for the company |
| `legalEntityId` | `["64f5a093cf03b40701653958"]` | Returns all equity data for the legal entity |
| `normalizedData` | `{ "min": 0, "max": 10000000 }` | Filter by equity range |
| `normalizedTimeStamp` | `{ "min": "01/01/2001", "max": "01/01/2020" }` | Filter by equity date range |

> **Notes:** 
  

---

## Sorts Applicable

| Sort Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `normalizedData` | Equity values |
| `normalizedTimeStamp` | Equity timestamps |

---

## Output Keys

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Unique Time-Series ID in Tracxn DB |
| `attributeName` | string | Attribute name (e.g., BalanceSheetEquity) |
| `legalEntityId` | string | Legal Entity ID associated with the time-series data |
| `companyIds` | list | List of associated company IDs |

### `data` Object

| Path | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data.amount.INR.value` | double | Equity value in INR |
| `data.amount.USD.value` | double | Equity value in USD |
| `data.amount.EUR.value` | double | Equity value in EUR |
| `data.amount.GBP.value` | double | Equity value in GBP |
| `data.amount.SGD.value` | double | Equity value in SGD |

### `timestamp` Object

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `timestamp.isRange` | boolean | Indicates whether the timestamp is a date range |

**If** **`isRange = true`****:**

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `timestamp.dateRange.start.day` | int | Start day |
| `timestamp.dateRange.start.month` | int | Start month |
| `timestamp.dateRange.start.year` | int | Start year |
| `timestamp.dateRange.end.day` | int | End day |
| `timestamp.dateRange.end.month` | int | End month |
| `timestamp.dateRange.end.year` | int | End year |

**If** **`isRange = false`****:**

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `timestamp.date.day` | int | Equity date day |
| `timestamp.date.month` | int | Equity date month |
| `timestamp.date.year` | int | Equity date year |

---

## Key Metrics API

The **Key Metrics API** enables users to retrieve aggregated data metrics across various datasets.

Supported datasets include:

- **Companies**
- **Funding Rounds** *(See separate documentation for each in the Key Metrics API collection)*
- **Investors**
- **Acquisitions**

---

### What is Aggregation?

Aggregation enables analytical insights by performing calculations and statistical operations across a set of documents. It also allows grouping data into buckets based on fields such as text or date, enabling structured and meaningful analysis.

---

### Types of Aggregation

1. **One-Level Aggregation**  
   - Aggregates metrics across the **entire filtered dataset**.
   - Returns overall metrics (e.g., count, sum, average).

2. **Two-Level Aggregation**  
   - Aggregates metrics **and groups** them by a specific field (e.g., `country`, `sector`, or `round type`).
   - Useful for **segment-level** analysis.

---

# Feed API Documentation

## Overview

The **Feed API** allows you to query Tracxn’s feed database using multiple filters to retrieve structured feed-level information.

---

## Endpoints

- **Production:**  
    `https://platform.tracxn.com/api/3.0/feeds`
    

---

## Method

- `POST`
    

---

## Headers

| Header Key | Value | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accessToken` | `[Your Access Token]` | Yes | Provided by Tracxn |
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` | Yes | Must be set to `application/json` |
| `X-Request-Source` | `prodAPI` (optional) | No | Optional tracking header |

---

---

## Body Parameters

- `filter`: Criteria to filter feed details.
    
- `sort`: Criteria to sort the feed data.
    
- `from`: Pagination offset (default: 0).
    
- `size`: Number of results returned per response (default and maximum: 20).
    

---

## Sample Filter Payload

``` json
{
  "dataset": "query",
  "filter": {
    "id": "52ff2cfce4b0b193ed664d1a",
    "name": "Cybersecurity",
    "publishStatus": ["PUBLISHED"],
    "compsCurationStatus": ["ENABLED"]
  }
}

 ```

---

## Sample cURL Request

``` bash
curl --location 'https://platform.tracxn.com/api/3.0/feeds' \
--header 'accessToken: [Your Access Token]' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--header 'X-Request-Source: prodAPI' \
--data '{
  "dataset": "query",
  "filter": {
    "id": "52ff2cfce4b0b193ed664d1a",
    "name": "Cybersecurity",
    "publishStatus": ["PUBLISHED"],
    "compsCurationStatus": ["ENABLED"]
  }
}'

 ```

---

## Filters Applicable

| Filter Type | Sample Input |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `"id": ["52ff2cfce4b0b193ed664d1a"]` |
| Name | `"name": ["Cybersecurity"]` |
| Publish Status | `"publishStatus": ["PUBLISHED"]` |
| Comps Curation Status | `"compsCurationStatus": ["ENABLED"]` |

---

### Filter Notes

- Filters using `min` and `max` are inclusive.
    
- At least one of `min` or `max` is required in applicable filters.
    
- All filters are joined with an `AND` operator.
    
- Dates must be in `dd/mm/yyyy` format.

# Key Metrics API - Acquisitions

## Overview

The Key Metrics API enables users to retrieve aggregated data metrics for various data types, such as companies, funding rounds, investors, and acquisitions. The API supports single-level and two-level aggregation with customizable filters.

---

## Request Details

### URL (Production)

[https://platform.tracxn.com/api/3.0/acquisitions/metric](https://platform.tracxn.com/api/3.0/acquisitions/metric)

### Method

POST

### Headers

| Header | Value | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| accessToken | \[Access Token from Tracxn\] | Yes |
| Content-Type | application/json | Yes |

---

## Aggregation Modes

### One-Level Aggregation

Aggregates the metric over the entire filtered dataset.

``` json
{
  "filter": {
    "<filterName>": "<value>"
  },
  "metric": "<metricName>"
}

 ```

**Example:**

``` json
{
  "filter": {
    "practiceAreaId": [
      "5409cb72e4b0efef66413044"
    ]
  },
  "metric": "sumAcquisitionPrice"
}

 ```

---

### Two-Level Aggregation

Aggregates the metric and groups the result by a specified field.

``` json
{
  "filter": {
    "<filterName>": "<value>"
  },
  "metric": "<metricName>",
  "bucket": [
    {
      "field": "<aggregationKey>"
    }
  ]
}

 ```

**Example:**

``` json
{
  "filter": {
    "practiceAreaId": [
      "5409cb72e4b0efef66413044"
    ]
  },
  "metric": "averageAcquisitionPrice",
  "bucket": [
    {
      "field": "country"
    }
  ]
}

 ```

> **Note:** Only top 20 groups are returned for two-level aggregation. 
  

---

## Metric Name \[Acquisitions\]

| Metric Name | Description | Example Use Case |
| --- | --- | --- |
| count | Total count of entities that match the specified filters | Get the number of acquisitions in a sector |
| sumAcquisitionPrice | Total acquisition price across all entities matching the filters | Calculate total acquisition value for a sector |
| medianAcquisitionPrice | Median acquisition value to understand the typical price without being skewed by outliers | Median acquisition value in a region |
| averageAcquisitionPrice | Average acquisition price over all entities that match the filters | Analyze average acquisition price for tech firms |

---

## Allowed Filters and Aggregation Keys for \[Acquisitions\]

### Sector Filters

| Filter | Sample | Aggregation Allowed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `practiceAreaId` | `practiceAreaId`: `["5409cf05e4b0831de3527d64"]` | Yes |
| `feedId` | `feedId`: `["538ca013e4b01fd726a7b617"]` | Yes |
| `businessModelHierarchy` | `businessModelHierarchy`: `["5b8e5eae4f0ca1fbcd668f14"]` | Yes |

### Location Filters

| Filter | Sample | Aggregation Allowed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| country | \["United States", "Israel"\] | Yes |
| countryAndCountryGroupId | \["58075391e4b00a7b5be3ad99"\] | Yes |
| continent | \["Asia", "Europe"\] | Yes |
| continentAndContinentGroupId | \["5cb5bff887870743a49871c1"\] | Yes |
| city | \["San Francisco", "Boston"\] | Yes |
| cityAndCityGroupId | \["57c6a01ae4b07365c7e4a08f"\] | Yes |

### Company Filters

| Filter | Sample | Aggregation Allowed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| foundedYear | \[2008, 2009\] | Yes |

### Acquisition Filters

| Filter | Sample | Aggregation Allowed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| announcementDate | { "min": "01/01/2020", "max": "30/09/2020" } | Yes |
| acquisitionType | \["Acqui-Hired","Management Buyout","Business Acquisition"\] | Yes |

---

## Sample Request and Response

### One-Level Aggregation

**Sample Request for** **`count`** **for India:**

``` json
{
  "filter": {
    "country": [
      "India"
    ]
  },
  "metric": "count"
}

 ```

**Sample Response:**

``` json
{
  "result": 4923
}

 ```

---

### Two-Level Aggregation

**Sample Request for** **`count`** **grouped by** **`acquisitionType`****:**

``` json
{
  "filter": {
    "practiceAreaId": [
      "5409cb72e4b0efef66413044"
    ],
    "country": [
      "India"
    ]
  },
  "metric": "count",
  "bucket": [
    {
      "field": "acquisitionType"
    }
  ]
}

 ```

**Sample Response:**

``` json
{
  "result": [
    {
      "term": "Business Acquisition",
      "value": 60
    },
    {
      "term": "Acqui-Hired",
      "value": 34
    }
  ]
}

 ```

# Transactions API

The Transactions API allows you to query the Transaction (Funding Rounds) Database and apply multiple filters and sorts.

---

## Request Details

### URL (Production)

`https://platform.tracxn.com/api/2.2/transactions`

### Method

`POST`

### Headers

| Header | Value | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| accessToken | \[Access Token from Tracxn\] | Yes |
| Content-Type | application/json | Yes |

---

## Body (Payload)

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `filter` | Criteria by which you want to filter Transactions (Funding Rounds) |
| `sort` | Criteria to sort the Transactions |
| `from` | Pagination offset (default = 0) |
| `size` | Max 100, optional (default = 20) |

---

## Sample cURL Request

``` bash
curl -X POST \
https://platform.tracxn.com/api/2.2/transactions \
-H 'accesstoken: [access-token-given-by-tracxn]' \
-H 'cache-control: no-cache' \
-H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
-d '{
  "filter": {
    "transactionFundingRoundDate": {
      "min": "01/01/2018",
      "max": "30/01/2018"
    }
  },
  "sort": [
    {
      "sortField": "transactionFundingRoundAmount"
    }
  ]
}'

 ```

---

## Filters

## Company Filters

| Filter | Sample | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `domain` | `"domain": ["tracxn.com"]` | Returns funding round records for companies with the specified domain |
| `companyStage` | `"companyStage": ["Unfunded", "Series A", "Late-Stage"]` | Returns funding round records for companies in the specified stage |
| `foundedYear` | `"foundedYear": [2008, 2009]` | Returns funding round records for companies founded in the specified year(s) |
| `partOf` | `"partOf": ["tracxn.com"]` | Returns funding round records for companies that are a part of the specified parent domain |
| `domainSuffix` | `"domainSuffix": ["com", "ai"]` | Returns funding round records for companies whose domain ends with the specified suffix |
| `query` | `"query": ["+Blockchain +Legal"]` | Returns funding round records for companies matching the specified keyword(s) |
| `firstPublishDate` | `"firstPublishDate": { "min": "01/01/2016", "max": "30/06/2016" }` | Date when the company was first published on the platform |
| `companiesId` | `"companiesId": ["nrG5itQu_3voVifgJjj52SGgucwK5dAJUNozT6vhxPw"]` | Returns funding round records for specified company IDs |

## Funding Round Filters

| Filter | Sample | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `transactionFundingRoundCategory` | `"transactionFundingRoundCategory": ["Series B", "Series C"]` | Returns funding round records that belong to the specified funding round category |
| `isKeyFundingRound` | `"isKeyFundingRound": true` | Returns funding round records marked as key rounds for the company |
| `transactionFundingRoundDate` | `"transactionFundingRoundDate": { "min": "01/01/2016", "max": "30/06/2016" }` | Returns funding round records within the specified funding round date range |
| `transactionInvestor` | `"transactionInvestor": { "transactionInstitutionalInvestorDomain": ["sequoiacap.com"] }` | Returns funding round records where the given investor participated |
| `leadRoundFacilitators` | `"leadRoundFacilitators": ["wellsfargo.com"]` | Returns funding round records where specified entity acted as lead facilitator |
| `transactionInvestorFeedName` | `"transactionInvestorFeedName": ["Venture Capital Funds"]` | Returns funding round records linked to investors belonging to specified feed |
| `roundFacilitators` | `"roundFacilitators": ["wellsfargo.com"]` | Returns funding round records where specified entity acted as facilitator |
| `leadTransactionInvestor` | `"leadTransactionInvestor": —` | Returns funding round records where specified investor acted as lead investor |
| `transactionAllInvestorCountryAndCountryGroup` | `"transactionAllInvestorCountryAndCountryGroup": ["India", "United States"]` | All countries/country groups where transaction investors are located |
| `transactionAllInvestorStateAndStateGroup` | `"transactionAllInvestorStateAndStateGroup": ["Maharashtra"]` | All states/state groups representing locations of transaction investors |
| `transactionAllInvestorCityAndCityGroup` | `"transactionAllInvestorCityAndCityGroup": ["Bengaluru"]` | All cities/city groups corresponding to locations of transaction investors |
| `createdDate` | `"createdDate": { "min": "01/01/2001", "max": "01/01/2300" }` | Returns funding round records created within specified date range |

## Location Filters

| Filter | Sample | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `country` | `"country": ["United States"]` | Returns funding round records for companies located in specified country |
| `state` | `"state": ["California"]` | Returns funding round records for companies located in specified state |
| `city` | `"city": ["San Francisco"]` | Returns funding round records for companies located in specified city |
| `continent` | `"continent": ["Asia"]` | Returns funding round records for companies located in specified continent |
| `location` | `"location": { "country": ["United States"], "state": ["California"] }` | Returns funding round records for companies in specified location |

## Funding Filters

| Filter | Sample | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `totalMoneyRaised` | `"totalMoneyRaised": { "min": 2000000, "max": 20000000 }` | Returns companies whose total money raised falls within specified range |
| `investor` | `"investor": { "domain": ["google.com"] }` | Returns companies with specified investors |
| `latestFundingRoundDate` | `"latestFundingRoundDate": { "min": "01/01/2016", "max": "30/06/2016" }` | Returns companies whose latest funding round date falls within specified range |
| `fundingRoundDate` | `"fundingRoundDate": { "min": "01/01/2016", "max": "30/06/2016" }` | Returns funding round records within specified date range |

## Sector Filters

| Filter | Sample | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `specialFlags` | `"specialFlags": { "consumer": ["yes"], "saas": ["untagged"] }` | Returns funding round records for companies with specified special flag values |
| `practiceArea` | `"practiceArea": ["Fintech"]` | Returns funding round records for companies tagged with specified practice area |
| `feedName` | `"feedName": ["HRTech"]` | Returns funding round records for companies associated with specified feed name(s) |
| `businessModel` | `"businessModel": —` |  |
| `businessModelPath` | `"businessModelPath": [{ "feedId": ["5b8e5eae..."], "businessModel": ["533d2b58..."] }]` | Returns funding round records for companies mapped to specified taxonomy IDs |

## Analyst Rating Filters

| Filter | Sample | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `editorRating` | `"editorRating": [4, 5]` | Returns funding round records for companies with specified editor rating(s) |
| `soonicornFlag` | `"soonicornFlag": ["UNICORN"]` | Returns funding round records for companies tagged with specified Soonicorn category |
| `soonicornEventDate` | `"soonicornEventDate": { "min": "01/01/2016", "max": "30/06/2016" }` | Returns funding round records where Soonicorn event date is within specified range |
| `editorRatingUpdatedDate` | `"editorRatingUpdatedDate": { "min": "01/01/2016", "max": "30/06/2016" }` | Returns funding round records where editor rating updated date is within range |
| `soonicornMarkedDate` | `"soonicornMarkedDate": { "min": "01/01/2016", "max": "30/06/2016" }` | Returns funding round records where Soonicorn marked date is within range |

## Transaction Filters

| Filter | Sample | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `transactionFundingRoundAmount` | `"transactionFundingRoundAmount": { "min": 1000000, "max": 1000000000 }` | Returns funding round records where round amount lies within specified range |
| `transactionFirstFundingRoundDate` | `"transactionFirstFundingRoundDate": { "min": "01/01/2016", "max": "30/06/2016" }` | Returns funding round records where first funding round date is within range |
| `transactionId` | `"transactionId": ["52fe3238e4b0576112f617a1"]` | Returns funding round records matching specified transaction ID |

## Exits Filters

| Filter | Sample | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `acquirerDomain` | `"acquirerDomain": ["google.com"]` | Returns funding round records for companies acquired by acquirer with specified domain |
| `acquisitionAmount` | `"acquisitionAmount": { "min": 2000000, "max": 20000000 }` | Returns funding round records where acquisition amount falls within range |
| `acquisitionType` | `"acquisitionType": ["Acqui-Hired", "Buyout"]` | Returns funding round records for companies with specified acquisition type(s) |
| `acquisitionDate` | `"acquisitionDate": { "min": "01/01/2016", "max": "30/06/2016" }` | Returns funding round records where acquisition date is within range |
| `companyAcquirerFeedName` | `"companyAcquirerFeedName": ["SaaS"]` | Returns funding rounds for companies acquired by acquirers under specified feed |
| `acquirerCountry` | `"acquirerCountry": ["India"]` | Returns funding round records for companies acquired by acquirer in specified country |
| `acquirerState` | `"acquirerState": ["Karnataka"]` | Returns funding round records for companies acquired by acquirer in specified state |
| `acquirerCity` | `"acquirerCity": ["Bengaluru"]` | Returns funding round records for companies acquired by acquirer in specified city |

## Metrics Filters

| Filter | Sample | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `twitterFollowerGrowthPercent` | `"twitterFollowerGrowthPercent": { "min": 2, "max": 20 }` | Funding rounds of companies whose twitter followers growth percent is in range |
| `mobileReviewGrowthPercent` | `"mobileReviewGrowthPercent": { "min": 2, "max": 20 }` | Funding rounds of companies whose mobile review growth percent is in range |

## Discovery Filters

| Filter | Sample | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `latestNewsDate` | `"latestNewsDate": { "min": "01/01/2016", "max": "30/06/2016" }` | Returns funding round records where latest news date falls within range |

---

## Sorts Applicable

### Funding Round Details

| Sort Field |
| --- |
| `transactionFundingRoundAmount` |
| `transactionFundingRoundDate` |
| `transactionRoundName` |
| `transactionFirstFundingRoundDate` |
| `createdDate` |

### Analyst Rating

| Sort Field |
| --- |
| `soonicornEventDate` |

### Discovery

| Sort Field |
| --- |
| `latestNewsDate` |

---

## Output Keys

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | string | Type of transaction |
| `id` | string | Unique identifier of the Funding Round record in the Tracxn database. |
| `name` | string | Name of the round (e.g. Series A) |
| `fundingDate` | object | Date of funding round |
| `fundingDate.year` | int | Year |
| `fundingDate.month` | int | Month |
| `fundingDate.day` | int | Day |

### Company Details

| --- | --- | --- |
| `companyDetails.name` | string | Company name |
| `companyDetails.id` | string | Tracxn DB ID |
| `companyDetails.domain` | string | Company domain |

### News Info

### Amount

| `currency` | string | Currency used |

### Investors

| `investorList[].name` | string | Investor name |

# Key Metrics API - Funding Rounds

## Overview

The Key Metrics API enables users to retrieve aggregated data metrics for various data types, such as companies, funding rounds, investors, and acquisitions. The API supports single-level and two-level aggregation with customizable filters.

---

## Request Details

### URL (Production)

[https://platform.tracxn.com/api/3.0/fundingrounds/metric](https://platform.tracxn.com/api/3.0/fundingrounds/metric)

### Method

POST

### Headers

| Header | Value | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| accessToken | \[Access Token from Tracxn\] | Yes |
| Content-Type | application/json | Yes |

---

## Aggregation Modes

### One-Level Aggregation

Aggregates the metric over the entire filtered dataset.

``` json
{
  "filter": {
    "<filterName>": "<value>"
  },
  "metric": "<metricName>"
}

 ```

**Example:**

``` json
{
  "filter": {
    "practiceAreaId": [
      "5409cb72e4b0efef66413044"
    ]
  },
  "metric": "averageFundingAmount"
}

 ```

---

### Two-Level Aggregation

Aggregates the metric and groups the result by a specified field.

``` json
{
  "filter": {
    "<filterName>": "<value>"
  },
  "metric": "<metricName>",
  "bucket": [
    {
      "field": "<aggregationKey>"
    }
  ]
}

 ```

**Example:**

``` json
{
  "filter": {
    "practiceAreaId": [
      "5409cb72e4b0efef66413044"
    ]
  },
  "metric": "sumFundingAmount",
  "bucket": [
    {
      "field": "city"
    }
  ]
}

 ```

> **Note:** Only top 20 groups are returned for two-level aggregation. 
  

---

## Metric Name \[Funding Rounds\]

| Metric Name | Description | Example Use Case |
| --- | --- | --- |
| sumFundingAmount | Total funding amount aggregated across all applicable entities | Calculate total sector funding |
| averageFundingAmount | Average funding amount across all matching entities | Analyze average investment size |
| medianFundingAmount | Median funding value to understand typical funding without outliers | Median funding in regions |
| count | Count of funding rounds that match the filters | Total number of funding rounds |

### Company Filters

- **Consumption:** Based on **unique companies** retrieved
    
- **Best For:** Deep dives, enrichment, and analysis

# Custom List API

The Custom List API is used to get the Custom List ID. Using this ID in the Companies API call, users can retrive the details of the companies in that Custom list.

## Detailed Steps

**Step 1**:  
Use the Custom List API to get the "tracxnId" (Custom List ID)

**Step 2**:  
Use this ID in the Companies API with the filter `bookmarkListId` to get the details of the companies in that Custom list.

**Example**:

``` json
{
    "filter": {
        "bookmarkListId": [
            "<ID>"
        ]
    }
}

 ```

---

**URL**:  
[https://platform.tracxn.com/api/2.2/bookmarkslist](https://platform.tracxn.com/api/2.2/bookmarkslist)

**Method**:  
POST

**Headers**:

- accessToken: \[accessToken as given by Tracxn\]
    
- Content-Type: application/json
    

**Body (Payload)**:

``` json
{
    "filter": {}
}

 ```

curl -X POST \
https://platform.tracxn.com/api/2.2/bookmarkslist \
-H 'accesstoken: [access-token-given-by-tracxn]' \

# Companies Name Search API (Version 2.2)

The **Companies Name Search API** enables you to search for companies by their name and receive matching company IDs and domains in the response.

You can then use these IDs or domains with the Companies API to fetch detailed company data.

---

## Request Details

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| **Production URL** | `https://platform.tracxn.com/api/2.2/companies/search` |
| **Method** | `POST` |
| **Headers** | `accessToken`: `[Your Access Token]``Content-Type`: `application/json` |

---

## Sample cURL Request

``` bash
curl -X POST \
  https://platform.tracxn.com/api/2.2/companies/search \
  -H 'accesstoken: [access-token-given-by-tracxn]' \
  -H 'cache-control: no-cache' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
        "filter": {
            "companyName": ["apple"]
        }
    }'

 ```

---

## Sample Request Body (Filter)

``` json
{
  "filter": {
    "companyName": ["apple"]
  }
}

 ```

4. `from` and `size` parameters are **not applicable** for this endpoint.
    

---

POST

---

## Body (Payload)

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `filter` | Criteria to filter liabilities time-series data |
| `sort` | Criteria to sort the liabilities time-series data |
| `from` | Pagination offset (default = 0) |
| `size` | Max 100, optional (default = 20) |

---

``` json
{
  "from": 0,
  "filter": {
    "companyId": [
      "67a5d7bf767e0424f0c445e0"
    ]
  }
}

 ```

``` bash
curl -X POST \
https://platform.tracxn.com/api/3.0/timeseries/balancesheetliability \
-H 'accesstoken: [access-token-given-by-tracxn]' \
-H 'cache-control: no-cache' \
-H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
-d '{
  "from": 0,
  "filter": {
    "companyId": ["67a5d7bf767e0424f0c445e0"]
  }
}'

 ```

| Filter | Sample | Description |

> **Notes:**

## Output Keys

| `attributeName` | string | Attribute name (e.g., BalanceSheetLiability) |
| `legalEntityId` | string | Legal Entity ID associated with the time-series data |
| `companyIds` | list | List of associated company IDs |

### `data` Object

| Path | Type | Description |

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |

**If** **`isRange = true`****:**

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `timestamp.dateRange.start.day` | int | Start day |
| `timestamp.dateRange.start.month` | int | Start month |
| `timestamp.dateRange.start.year` | int | Start year |
| `timestamp.dateRange.end.day` | int | End day |
| `timestamp.dateRange.end.month` | int | End month |
| `timestamp.dateRange.end.year` | int | End year |

**If** **`isRange = false`****:**

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `timestamp.date.day` | int | Liability date day |
| `timestamp.date.month` | int | Liability date month |
| `timestamp.date.year` | int | Liability date year |

---
